Good morning and warm greetings from Mazars,

We are writing to express our keen interest in participating in your Annual Supplier due diligence process. We would greatly appreciate any assistance you could offer in this regard.

Thank you for your attention to this matter, and we look forward to the opportunity to collaborate with you in the near future.
